event: US PPI on Fri 13 Nov (time UNVERIFIED, likely 15:30 SAST). No confirmed high-impact US release today.

bullets.title: Small bounce
bullets.text: Gold was 3,997.40 at 03:19 SAST, up 10.40 (+0.26%) after Wednesday's low of 3,967.90 and high of 4,067.90 (Kitco).

bullets.title: Still under 4,000
bullets.text: Goodreturns had spot near 3,987 in early Asia trade, so price is hovering just under the broken 4,000 level.

bullets.title: Dollar near highs
bullets.text: The dollar index is about 102.87, near its highest since April 2025, and the US yield is near 4.99% (Trading Economics; Goodreturns says 102.7-102.9).

bullets.title: December hike priced
bullets.text: CME FedWatch odds for a December hike are cited at 100%, up from 84% before CPI, though a Nov 11 report said 91% (sources differ, UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Hawkish Fed
bullets.text: Waller said core inflation could justify a half-point hike as soon as December, and Paulson and Bowman also sounded hawkish (Goodreturns).

bullets.title: Oil and Iran
bullets.text: Brent is near 92-93 dollars amid a US-Iran stalemate, which keeps some safe-haven and inflation risk in play (Trading Economics, Goodreturns).

buy.title: Buy plan: hold at 3,885-3,904 (counter-trend)

keys.label: Buy zone
keys.value: 3,885-3,904, only after a dip that holds

look: This is counter-trend. The bias is down, so use half size or skip it.
Price reaching 3,885-3,904 and a 15M close back up out of the zone.
A 1H higher low inside the zone.
The dollar index easing back below 102.7.
Take some profit at 3,935 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Buying now at 3,997 because of the small bounce. The trend is still down.
More hawkish Fed comments or Friday's US PPI can extend the drop fast.
Thin liquidity overnight in Asia can make wicks go through the zone.
Moving your stop lower when price gets close. That is how a small loss becomes a big one.

sell.title: Sell plan: rejection at 3,997-4,017
look: Price bouncing back up to 3,997-4,017 and stalling there.
A clear 15M rejection wick or bearish close inside the zone.
The dollar index holding near 102.9 or higher.
Take some profit at 3,968 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Price is already in the zone. Wait for a clear rejection candle, not just the touch.
A 1H close back above 4,022 means the break failed, and price can squeeze to 4,025-4,036.
Safe-haven headlines, such as the Hormuz tensions Kitco mentions, can bring buyers back fast.
Re-entering again and again after being stopped out. One attempt, then step away.
